name: Necessary Code: will cause error if these are not included Defines the unit raw name, game uses it to identify as a unique name. (This is not displayed in-game)
mass: name. (This is not displayed in-game) The 'weight' of the unit, defines how it collides with other units, a greater value means it's tougher to push.
radius: a greater value means it's tougher to push. Circular area around the unit that makes it selectable. (mouse click/screen touch)
price: click/screen touch) The unit cost from builders/buildings. Defaults to credits if no resource type is used
maxHp: resource type is used The max health for the unit. (will spawn with this value).
buildSpeed: Common Keys Time it takes to build the unit. (may multiply with builder speed)
class: Reserved for future use, must be CustomUnitMetadata by default.
techLevel: default. Defines the Tech Level of the unit, there're 3 levels and each will appear in a different color in the GUI.
altNames: will appear in a different color in the GUI. Comma separated list of names. Like name but lower priority, useful for multiple optional mods.
strictLevel: Defaults to 0. 1 = Errors if keys are duplicated. Add to "all- units.template" in root to apply to all units.
isBio: units.template" in root to apply to all units. Choose whether the unit is bioligical or not, affects sound and splat (unless hideScorchMark:true)
isBug: splat (unless hideScorchMark:true) Changes some death defaults, and sort order in Sandbox.
isBuilder: Normally required if this unit places buildings. Defaults to [ai] useAsBuilder.
streamingCost: useAsBuilder. Like price but paid for overtime while this unit is being queued or built. Construction or queue is paused if resources run out
switchPriceWithStreamingCost: while building. Shortcut to set streamingCost to price value and clear price, add to all-units.template to quickly switch a mod over to streaming resources.
selfRegenRate: Unit Stats Keys Passive self repair rate.
maxShield: The max shield hitpoints of the unit. Can start with 0 hitpoints if startShieldAtZero:true.
startShieldAtZero: startShieldAtZero:true. Unit starts with a 0 hitpoints shield on created if true.
energyMax: Defaults to 0. Energy that can be used as ammo for turrets, laser defense and actions.
energyRegen: laser defense and actions. Passive energy regen rate.
energyStartingPercentage: Sets the percentage of charged energy when the unit is first built.
energyNeedsToRechargeToFull: built. Disables weapons using energy after reaching zero till fully recharged if true.
energyRegenWhenRecharging: recharged if true. Regen rate while recharging.
armour: Damage taken away from each hit. (not currently used in any vanilla units)
armourMinDamageToKeep: vanilla units) Min damage to keep from received damage. Defaults to 1.
borrowResourcesWhileAlive: Takes these resources when created and returns them when removed or destroyed.
borrowResourcesWhileBuilt: removed or destroyed. Like borrowResourcesWhileAlive but doesn't take affect till built. Mostly useful for buildings like houses that have negative resources to add to the unit cap, etc.
generation_resources: resources to add to the unit cap, etc. Income unit creates. (custom resource version)
generation_delay: How often generation_resources/credits is added. Defaults to 40. (changing not recommended)
showInEditor: UI and Graphics Keys Set to false to hide unit in Sandbox editor. (Defaults to true)
displayText: The unit name that the game shows to the player.
displayText_{LANG}: LANG = ISO 639-1 Code to show this text instead when game is in this language.
displayDescription: is in this language. Unit description that the game shows to the player.
displayDescription_{LANG}: LANG = ISO 639-1 Code to show this text instead when game is in this language.
displayLocaleKey: is in this language. Translation file key for unit name and description.
displayRadius: Defaults to radius value. Set to show a larger or smaller selection circle UI on units.
shieldRenderRadius: attacking/reclaiming/etc this unit Defaults is a little bigger than radius. Set to show a larger or smaller shield circle on units.
shieldDisplayOnlyDeflection: Hide shield unless deflecting shot if true.
shieldDeflectionDisplayRate: Defaults to 4. High value causes shield deflection to fade disappear faster.
showOnMinimap: disappear faster. Defaults to true. Hide units on minimap if false.
showActionsWithMixedSelectionIfOtherUnit: Shows a merged action list if all units selected includes one of these tags. Useful for converted units.
isBuilding: Building Only Keys Defines if the unit is a building.
footprint: Left, up, right, down. Tiles taken up which block unit movement. Defaults to 0,0,0,0 = 1 center tile.
constructionFootprint: movement. Defaults to 0,0,0,0 = 1 center tile. Tiles taken up for placement of other buildings. Defaults to 0,0,0,0 = 1 center tile.
displayFootprint: 0,0,0,0 = 1 center tile. Left, up, right, down. Only applies to buildings, just used for GUI. Defaults to footprint.
buildingSelectionOffset: GUI. Defaults to footprint. Defaults to 0. Adds or removes padding on the drawn selection rect in UI.
buildingToFootprintOffsetX: rect in UI. Defaults to 10. Change the building position in the footprint on the X-axis.
buildingToFootprintOffsetY: the X-axis. Defaults to 10. Change the building position in the footprint on the Y-axis.
placeOnlyOnResPool: the Y-axis. Normally used for extractors, forces building construction in a resource pool.
selfBuildRate: resource pool. Rate unit builds itself when placed without a builder.
copyFrom: Misc Keys Uses unit data from another ini file as default for this unit, supports multiple files.
dont_load: supports multiple files. Do not load unit, and don't error on missing data. Can be useful when used with copyFrom.
overrideAndReplace: useful when used with copyFrom. Overrides another unit with this unit. Build links and map positions to target unit will be replaced.
onNewMapSpawn: Values: emptyResourcePools_asNeutral, emptyOrOccupiedResourcePools_asNeutral, mapCenter_asNeutral, mapCenter_eachActiveTeam, spawnPoint_eachActiveTeam (1.15)
globalScale: spawnPoint_eachActiveTeam (1.15) Defaults to 1. Changing not recommended.
isLocked: Disallow building of this unit. Can be used with overrideAndReplace to restrict units player can build.
isLockedIfGameModeNoNuke: overrideAndReplace to restrict units player can build. Disallows building of this unit if nukes are disabled during match setup.
experimental: match setup. Tag unit as experimental. Affects zoomed out icon and end game stats.
stayNeutral: game stats. Set to false to disable capture when unit is on the neutral team.
createNeutral: Set to true to always spawn the unit on the neutral team.
createOnAggressiveTeam: Set to true to always spawn the unit on aggressive teams on single player matches.
tags: single player matches. List of comma separated strings. Used to classify units, create special actions and balances.
fogOfWarSightRange: Sets number of tiles this unit can see through the fog of war. Defaults to 15.
softCollisionOnAll: fogOfWarSightRange Creates a soft collision effect when touching other units.
disableAllUnitCollisions: Unit cannot collide with others if true.
isUnrepairableUnit: No unit can repair this unit if true.
isUnselectable: If true unit cannot be selected. (includes AI players)
isPickableStartingUnit: cannot be selected but can be targeted for attack, reclaim, etc If true, unit is added to dropdowns for starting unit in game setup menus.
startFallingWhenStartingUnit: setup menus. Unit will appear falling from skies when starting unit if true.
soundOnAttackOrder: List of sound names. Only one will be played on each attack order. Only .ogg and .wav formats.
soundOnMoveOrder: order. Only .ogg and .wav formats. List of sound names. Only one will be played on each move order. Only .ogg and .wav formats.
soundOnNewSelection: order. Only .ogg and .wav formats. List of sound names. Only one will be played on each unit selection. Only .ogg and .wav formats.
canNotBeDirectlyAttacked: selection. Only .ogg and .wav formats. No unit can directly target this unit. If true this will also skip this unit in victory/defeat checks. If true, canNotBeDamaged is true by default
canNotBeGivenOrdersByPlayer: forever) If true unit will not take player or AI orders.
canOnlyBeAttackedByUnitsWithTags: List of tag strings, only units with these tags can directly target this unit.
transportSlotsNeeded: Transport Keys Defaults to 1. Number of slots this unit uses up in a transport, experimentals are often set to 5.
transportUnitsRequireTag: Number of slots this units has for transporting other units. Only allows trasport of units that have one of these tags.
transportUnitsRequireMovementType: Only allows trasport of units that have one of these movement types.
transportUnitsBlockAirAndWaterUnits: types. Defaults to true. This unit can only transport LAND units if true.
transportUnitsEachUnitAlwaysUsesSingleSl: Defaults to false. Units in this transport occupy 1 slot always if true, ignoring transportSlotsNeeded.
transportUnitsKeepBuiltUnits: true, ignoring transportSlotsNeeded. Makes built units stay inside transport instead of exiting it once ready if true.
transportUnitsCanUnloadUnits: ready if true. Defaults to: if not self.isOverLiquid() and not self.isMoving(). This unit cannot unload units if false.
transportUnitsAddUnloadOption: This unit cannot unload units if false. Defines if unload button should be added to the unit menu
transportUnitsUnloadDelayBetweenEachUnit: Changes the delay it takes between each unit getting unloaded.
transportUnitsKillOnDeath: Defaults to true. If false transported units don't die when transport dies.
transportUnitsHealBy: transport dies. Rate to heal units that are being transported.
transportUnitsBlockOtherTransports: Defaults to true, if false this transports can hold other transports.
whileNeutralTransportAnyTeam: transports. This unit can transport units of any team while neutral if true.
whileNeutralConvertToTransportedTeam: Converts this unit to transported team while neutral. Useful with whileNeutralTransportAnyTeam.
convertToNeutralIfNotTransporting: with whileNeutralTransportAnyTeam. Reverts back this unit to neutral when unloaded. Useful with whileNeutralTransportAnyTeam.
transportUnitsOnTeamChangeKeepCurrentTea: whileNeutralTransportAnyTeam. Keeps transported units on their orginal team when this unit is converted if true.
resourceRate: Used with canReclaimResources. Allows other teams to reclaim this unit. Normally used with neutral team. Use price to set what resources are gained.
similarResourcesHaveTag: set what resources are gained. When this has been reclaimed harvester unit moves on to another resource with these tags.
resourceMaxConcurrentReclaimingThis: another resource with these tags. Defaults to unlimited. Set to restict how many units can reclaim this resource at the same time.
reclaimPrice: this resource at the same time. Like price but for resources. Useful for buildable resources.
canReclaimResources: Resource Harvester Keys If true this unit can gather resources, useful with resourceRate.
canReclaimResourcesNextSearchRange: resourceRate. Defines the resource search range of this unit when its main gathered resource runs out.
canReclaimResourcesOnlyWithTags: gathered resource runs out. This unit is only allowed to gather resources with these tags.
canRepairBuildings: Repairs units with the specified tags Can this can heal ally buildings (isBuilder:true is required)
canRepairUnits: Can this can heal ally units. (isBuilder:true is required), canRepairBuildings required for buildings.
autoRepair: canRepairBuildings required for buildings. Automatically try and repair damaged units in nano range. (isBuilder:true is required)
nanoRange: (isBuilder:true is required) Defaults to 85. Defines the unit building/repair/reclaim range.
nanoRepairSpeed: Defaults to 0.2. Defines the unit nano repair/reclaim speed.
nanoBuildSpeed: Defaults to 1. Defines the unit nano building speed. (May multiply with target's buildSpeed)
nanoUnbuildSpeed: multiply with target's buildSpeed) How fast a builder reclaims an incomplete building (defaults to 1)
nanoReclaimSpeed: 1) How fast a builder reclaims a normal unit (not a resource unit)
nanoRangeForRepairIsMelee: Defines if this unit must touch its target to repair it.
nanoRangeForReclaimIsMelee: Defines if this unit must touch its target to reclaim it.
nanoRangeForRepair: Defines a specific range for the repair action of this unit.
nanoRangeForReclaim: Defines a specific range for the reclaim action of this unit.
nanoFactorySpeed: Defaults to 1. Multiplies the buildSpeed value of the created unit if this unit is a factory.
extraBuildRangeWhenBuildingThis: unit if this unit is a factory. Temporarily adds extra build range to builders to build this unit. Useful for water based buildings.
builtFrom_{NUM}_name: Useful for water based buildings. Useful if adding this unit to build to existing buildings. Like canBuild but in opposite direction.
builtFrom_{NUM}_pos: Order this build link appears in UI. Using canBuild instead is more recommended.
builtFrom_{NUM}_forceNano: more recommended. Build as if this is a building if true. (even if it's a unit)
builtFrom_{NUM}_isLocked: If true this unit cannot be built in this build link. (can be conditioned if logicBooleans are used)
builtFrom_{NUM}_isLockedMessage: conditioned if logicBooleans are used) Message shown when this build link is locked.
exit_x: Where created or unloaded units appears from the transport or building. Defaults to 0.
exit_y: building. Defaults to 0. Where created or unloaded units appears from the transport or building. Defaults to 5.
exit_dirOffset: building. Defaults to 5. Defaults to 180 for units and 0 for buildings. Defines the exit direction of created or unloaded units.
exit_heightOffset: direction of created or unloaded units. Defaults to 0. Defines the height where created or unloaded units appears.
exit_moveAwayAmount: units appears. Defaults to 70. Defines the distance that created or unloaded units moves from this unit.
dieOnConstruct: Death Keys Deletes this unit when it starts to build if true. (target building/unit likely will need selfBuildRate set)
dieOnZeroEnergy: building/unit likely will need selfBuildRate set) Kills this unit if energy level reaches zero when true.
numBitsOnDeath: Defines the number of scattered bit fragments when this unit dies.
nukeOnDeath: dies. Unit will spawn a nuke detonation built-in effect when dies if true.
nukeOnDeathRange: true. Defines the nuke effect range when using nukeOnDeath.
nukeOnDeathDamage: Defines the nuke effect area damage when using nukeOnDeath.
nukeOnDeathDisableWhenNoNuke: nukeOnDeath. Defaults to false. If true this unit will not explode with nuke when nukes are disabled in skirmish maps.
fireTurretXAtSelfOnDeath: when nukes are disabled in skirmish maps. Auto-shoot a specific turret when this unit dies.
explodeOnDeath: Defaults to true. Disables the unit death explode built-in effect if false.
explodeOnDeathGroundCollision: if false. Defaults to true. Disables the explode built-in effect on death when unit touches ground if false.
explodeTypeOnDeath: when unit touches ground if false. options: verysmall, small, normal, large, largeUnit, building, buildingNoShockwaveOrSmoke, verylargeBuilding
effectOnDeath: buildingNoShockwaveOrSmoke, verylargeBuilding Spawns built-in or custom effects when unit dies.
effectOnDeathGroundCollision: Like effectOnDeath but when unit touches ground. Useful for flying units.
unitsSpawnedOnDeath: flying units. Spawns these units when dies. Comma separated unit identifiers.
unitsSpawnedOnDeath_setToTeamOfLastAttac: identifiers. Units spawned on death will appear on the last attacker team if true.
hideScorchMark: true. Disables the death scorch mark leaved when unit dies if true.
soundOnDeath: Sets a custom sound for this unit death.
effectOnDeathIfUnbuilt: If the unit was not completed, and is destroyed, play this effect. Defaults to effectOnDeath
autoTriggerCooldownTime: Action Keys Post automatic action cooldown (Not detection cooldown). Defaults to 1s. Warning: Setting this too low for many units might effect performance depending on the action effects.
autoTriggerCooldownTime_allowDangerousHi: might effect performance depending on the action effects. Allows for auto action cooldown lower than 0.2s. Default to false. Not recommended.
autoTriggerCheckRate: options: everyFrame (default), every4Frames, every8Frames. Note: all triggers regardless of check rate are checked when first created and after an auto trigger cooldown. Note: Adding [core] autoTriggerCheckRate:every8Frames to all-units.template could have a large performance boost for mods with complex autoTriggers.
autoTriggerCheckWhileNotBuilt: a large performance boost for mods with complex autoTriggers. Defaults to false. autoTrigger of unit actions check even when not completely built if true
updateUnitMemory: completely built if true Faster memory update than [action_#] setUnitMemory. Useful on many applications.
updateUnitMemoryRate: many applications. Sets how often the memory is updated. Defaults at 1s. settings it to 0 will update memory every frame.
pos: units. Add "setRally" to create a rally button Order build link appears in this unit UI.
tech: Tech level. Mostly just affects build link colour in this unit UI. Defaults to 1.
forceNano: Defaults to 1. Builds target as if it was a building if true. (even if it's a unit)
isVisible: Hide this build link if true in this unit UI.
isLockedMessage: isLockedMessage if true. Set to tell to players why a unit is locked.
isLockedMessage_{LANG}: LANG = ISO 639-1 Code to show this text instead when game is in this language.
isLockedAlt: is in this language. Another reason for this to be locked. Just allows a different message to be shown.
isLockedAltMessage: message to be shown. Message for isLockedAlt.
isLockedAlt2: Like isLockedAlt but to show one more message.
addResources: Adds these resources to self when placing the building or producing the unit.
isGuiBlinking: prices. Generates a blinking effect in UI if true.
image: Common Keys File path to png image.
teamColoringMode: How pixels are used for team coloring, options: pureGreen, hueAdd, hueShift, disabled
image_back: hueAdd, hueShift, disabled An optional image drawn behind other units. Useful for factories that units exit
image_wreak: Image to show as a custom shield Image to use when unit dies. Can be NONE to leave no wreak
image_offsetX: Use this to adjust the graphics of a unit if it is too far off one side
image_offsetY: side Use this to adjust the graphics of a unit if it is too far off one side
image_offsetH: side Use this to adjust the height of the graphic, especially when using decals
scaleImagesTo: showOnMinimapToEnemies. Useful for stealth units. Resize image to fit this value in pixels. Effects leg, and shadow images as well.
imageScale: shadow images as well. Resize image. Defaults to 1. Effects leg, and shadow images as well.
drawLayer: as well. Land units normally default to ground or ground2 if transport. Options: wreaks, underwater, bottom, ground, ground2, experimentals, air, top
image_turret: Turrets (images can also be set on each turret) Default image for all turrets, can also be set per turret
teamColorsOnTurret: Defaults false. Apply team colours on turret as well. Also effects pre-turret images
scaleTurretImagesTo: effects pre-turret images Will cause crash if image_turret is not specified, even if image is set per turret
lock_body_rotation_with_main_turret: is set per turret Locks body image locked to the direction of the turret named "1" (turret_1) or the first turret defined (if a turret_1 is not defined)
image_shadow: Shadow Image file, NONE, AUTO or AUTO_ANIMATED. (AUTO will use image and make it transparent black only.)
shadowOffsetX: use image and make it transparent black only.) Adjusts shadow horizontally
lock_shadow_rotation_with_main_turret: Alternative to AUTO_ANIMATED shadow value. Locks body image shadow locked to first turret's direction
frame_width: Defaults to 1. Animations require this. Calculated for you if total frames is set, but can be overridden
splastEffect: Default frame when not playing an animation. First frame is 0 True to create a water wave effect when over water. Default false
dustEffect: false True to create a dust effect when over land. Default false
splastEffectReverse: True to also create effect when unit is reversing
dustEffectReverse: True to also create effect when unit is reversing
rotate_with_direction: Defaults to 5, affects both sides. Defaults to true. Makes unit body image locked to 0 degrees when false. Often used with animation_direction_*
animation_direction_units: when false. Often used with animation_direction_* 45 for 8 directions, 90 for 4 direction animation. Used with rotate_with_direction:false
animation_direction_strideX: rotate_with_direction:false Animation frames to offset on direction change.
animation_direction_strideY: Animation frames to offset on direction change. Used with frame_height.
showTransportBar: damaged unit/structure. Defaults to true. Shows the transport bar for transport units.
teamColorsUseHue: adaptable ways) False: Green pixels on unit gets converted to team color. True: Whole unit is tinted the team colour. Defaults to false
animation_TYPE_start: Whole unit is tinted the team colour. Defaults to false TYPE can be set to: attack, moving, idle. Use [animation] section instead for more control
animation_TYPE_end: section instead for more control End frame, must be larger then start
animation_TYPE_scale_start: Scale unit image. Defaults to 1. Useful for bio units or breathing effects.
animation_TYPE_scale_end: breathing effects. Scale unit image. Defaults to 1. Useful for bio units or breathing effects.
animation_TYPE_speed: breathing effects. Delay for each frame of animation. Larger values cause slower animation
animation_TYPE_pingPong: animation Play animation in reverse before repeating. Useful with scale_start/scale_end
canAttack: If set to false, can not attack any unit. Overrides other canAttack options altogether.
canAttackFlyingUnits: canAttack options altogether. can also be narrowed per turret. Note: not required if canAttack is false.
canAttackLandUnits: is false. can also be narrowed per turret in [turret_NAME]
canAttackUnderwaterUnits: can also be narrowed per turret in [turret_NAME]
shootDelay: Global delay, can also use delay on each turret. Set in seconds or ticks
canAttackNotTouchingWaterUnits: Default true. If false unit can only attack units in contact with the water. Used for units with torpedos. (can also be set per turret)
isMelee: Very useful if [turret]limitingAngle is used Used with a low attack range (like maxAttackRange: 9) makes src and target radius get added to range, and effects AI.
attackMovement: Are all turrets rotated when body rotates. Defaults to true normal/bomber. bomber attack movement will retreat when energy runs out
dieOnAttack: energy runs out Will die when it attacks.
isFixedFiring: Must aim body at target to shoot. Will often make the unit need to stop before it can aim and shoot.
aimOffsetSpread: to stop before it can aim and shoot. Offset each shot multiplied by target radius. Defaults to 0.6. aimOffsetSpread:0 will make unit always attack center
disablePassiveTargeting: Unit stops targeting after firing a shot. Rarely used or needed. Unit only attacks manually ordered target. Rarely used or needed.
x: Positioning/Stats Sets the horizontal position of the turret. 0 is center, negatives toward left, positives toward right.
y: toward left, positives toward right. Sets the vertical position of the turret. 0 is center, negatives toward bottom, positives toward top.
height: height Height of the unit in 3D, to be used with decals
size: Controls the distance between the center of the turret and the point from where projectiles spawn.
shouldResetTurret: attached turret will often be rotating when reversing) Defaults true. False to disable the reseting turret angle when idle
idleSpin: idle Spin rate when idle, used on missile turrets
attachedTo: A specific turret to connect to, it will rotate with it. No correlation to [attachment_x]
slave: Locks this turret's direction and shot cooldown to attached turret. Often used with warmup for multiple barrel guns
isMainNanoTurret: turret. Often used with warmup for multiple barrel guns Defaults to false. Turret to use for creating buildings, etc. should only be true on one turret, and should have canShoot set to false
energyUsage: Required energy to fire weapon. Same as resourceUsage: energy=X
delay: Timing Override global shootDelay for this turret
warmup: will be reset/removed Delay before firing a shot.
onShoot_freezeBodyMovementFor: On Shoot Freezes body movement while shooting.
barrelOffsetX_onOddShots: 0 by default. Sets a barrelX offset only during odd numbered shots, useful for twin-barreled units. Use with barrelX. Use the opposite value of barrelX for most cases.
canOnlyAttackUnitsWithTags: the water. Used for units with torpedos. Only attacks potential targets with specific tags
canOnlyAttackUnitsWithoutTags: Only attacks potential targets without specific tags
canAttackCondition: Normally, used to optionally disable a turret based on a LogicBoolean. Eg: this unit's height
canAttackMaxAngle: LogicBoolean. Eg: this unit's height Max angle to target for turret to be allowed for fire. Defaults to 5, don't set lower. Can be set to 181 for turrets that don't need to turn to fire missiles.
clearTurretTargetAfterFiring: to turn to fire missiles. Clears the turrets sub-target when using multi-targeting
limitingRange: Make this turret have less range than the maxAttackRange. Do not apply this to all turrets change maxAttackRange instead.
limitingMinRange: this angle. Sets minimum range for turret.
interceptProjectiles_andTargetingGroundU: Minimum distance required for intercepting projectile
interceptProjectiles_andUnderDistance: Defaults to 2000, distance inflight before firing
interceptProjectiles_andOverHeight: Defaults to 0. Sets the projectile target height limit
laserDefenceEnergyUse: Set to enable a projectile laser defence from this turret. Should also set the energyMax in core.
invisible: Graphics and effects Don't render this turret, but still can shoot, etc.
chargeEffectImage: Moves the image verticallly from the turret center. Used with warmup. Shows a scaling effect image on turret barrel when charging.
shoot_sound: charging/warming up Can be linked to an .ogg or .wav file, or one of the default game sounds (list at bottom of reference)
shoot_sound_vol: game sounds (list at bottom of reference) Sets the volume of the shoot sound
shoot_flame: Current types are: small, large, smoke, shockwave, or CUSTOM: effectSectionName
life: Core How long till this projectile gets removed if it hasn't hit a target, 300 might be a good starting point, change depending on speed and range
deflectionPower: speed and range Defaults to 1. Energy needed for laser defence to deflect. -1 to disable deflection (only disable for special weapons like flames)
autoTargetingOnDeadTarget: making area-denial weapons. Retarget to nearby unit if target dies while in transit
spawnUnit: "spawnProjectiles:LIST" in the Search function Spawn new units of this type at projectile explode location
flameWeapon: (withTag="[tagName]") Generates small flames on hit (only cosmetic)
directDamage: Damage Damage to target unit on hit. Does not work with targetGround: true as it won't have a clear unit to target
areaDamage: Damages on arrival of target with an area effect, use areaRadius to adjust size of damage. targetGround needs this to damage
areaRadius: As of 1.16, damage can accept dynamic values How wide areaDamage effects. Note this drops off (unless areaDamageNoFalloff is used)
speed: projectiles that split and rain down. Projectile default travel speed
ballistic: Controls the speed rampup for targetSpeed Makes projectiles fly up into the air and come down, instead of going in a straight line
ballistic_delaymove_height: going in a straight line Sets up to how high the projectile needs to be before moving normally
ballistic_height: normally Sets the target height of the projectile
targetGroundSpread: Randomly makes the shot inaccurate by this amount. Also used by weapons like the flamethrower
speedSpread: used by weapons like the flamethrower Randomly change the starting projectile speed by this amount
instantReuseLast: Hit target instantly Recycles last projectile fired, only one projectile ever exists. Can turn lasers into beam weapons by using lower rate of fire and setting this to true
gravity: value slightly slower than this key to produce the arches. Controls the pull for projectiles that target ground. Use together with initialUnguidedSpeedHeight
hitSound: Built-in image frame to use, starts at zero. Default true
lightSize: Renders light under the projectile Sets the size of the light emitted by the projectile. 1 value = 1 tile
largeHitEffect: hexcode in either RGB or ARGB format Creates a large explosion and accompanying sound on hit (only cosmetic)
lightingEffect: (only cosmetic) Draw as lighting works best with instant:true
laserEffect: Draw as laser works best with instant:true
slowDeathFall: OVER_CLIFF_WATER Used with large aircraft. Makes the unit fall slowly while maintaining its speed at the time of death.
moveSpeed: maintaining its speed at the time of death. Maximum movement speed of the unit. A value of 1 means (1 pixel * 60) per second (or 3 tiles per second)
moveAccelerationSpeed: pixel * 60) per second (or 3 tiles per second) Defines how fast units accelerate to max speed.
moveDecelerationSpeed: Don't make this too low or units will have trouble stopping at waypoints
reverseSpeedPercentage: 0.6 default. Over 0.4 will reverse for short distances (at 40% speed). If set to 1 will drive in reverse same as forwards. Useful if slow turning
landOnGround: Useful if slow turning Should flying unit land when idle.
targetHeight: Defaults to 0 but if AIR movementType default is 35
targetHeightDrift: Smooth animated height change. Defaults to 0 but if AIR movementType default is 1.5
startingHeightOffset: movementType default is 1.5 Sets the initial height on spawn. Defaults at 0.
heightChangeRate: Rate at which the unit changes height, either from converting or drifting
fallingAcceleration: or drifting The acceleration in which a unit drops
maxTurnSpeed: Sets the top turning speed of a unit
turnAcceleration: Defines how fast units accelerate to max turn speed.
moveSlidingMode: Makes the unit slide when moveDecelerationSpeed is lower, making them drift and feel natural
moveIgnoringBody: making them drift and feel natural Allows the unit to move without fully turning in the direction its moving, useful for ships and air units
moveSlidingDir: moving, useful for ships and air units Sets direction when sliding
joinsGroupFormations: Defaults to true. Changing not recommended. When false, the unit will directly move to the assigned waypoint without taking space consideration from neighboring units.
useAsBuilder: Set to true if unit can build or repair buildings. Defaults to [core] isBuilder.
disableUse: Defaults to true if unit can reclaim resources Disallow AI building this unit or building
maxGlobal: Buildings only Maximum amount allowed for a specific structure for an AI team per map
maxEachBase: Maximum amount allowed for a specific structure for an AI team per "base", usually around an extractor or spawn point. To check for an AI base in sandbox, enable Debug Mode and Click Shift + F3
buildPriority: Click Shift + F3 0-1. AI uses 0.8 for first land factory, 0.48 for air factory, 0.47 for first turret.
noneInBaseExtraPriority: for first turret. Adds to buildPriority, if this unit doesn't exist in the AIs base
noneGlobalExtraPriority: Adds to buildPriority, if this unit doesn't exist in the any where on the map
upgradedFrom: is too low. Create link to another unit to preserve max counts for upgraded and non-upgraded types in same base.
attach_x: once Sets the leg's attach point on the X axis.
attach_y: Sets the leg's attach point on the Y axis.
rotateSpeed: Sets the leg's rotation speed on movement
heightSpeed: unit. Sets how fast the leg rises while walking
holdDisMin: Delay before the leg moved Defaults to 7. Reposition leg at this distance if neighbor legs are not already repositioning.
holdDisMax: are not already repositioning. Defaults to 16. Force reposition of leg at this distance. Repositions leg at this distance even if a neighboring leg is moving
hardLimit: Checks neighbors before applying distance holding Defaults to 50. Force leg to never go this far. Better to not be reached.
hidden: Graphics and effects When true, hides the arm/leg
dust_effect: Rotates the foot/arm sprite to a specified direction Spawns dust particles on each step.
resetAngle: Apply height relative to unit's height Unused
createIncompleteIfParentIs: when selected If parent hasn't been built, create attachment with the same built value. Links built values till attachment is complete. Useful for buildings built with nano.
redirectDamageToParent: for buildings built with nano. Redirects damage done to this attachment to the parent instead of damaging itself directly
redirectDamageToParent_shieldOnly: instead of damaging itself directly When enemies attack the attachment, all damage are redirected to the parent's shield
textPostFix: Labels the action. Supports dynamic text Text shown as suffix, useful with textAddUnitName to create text UI
descriptionAddUnitStats: Add this unit's description to this action's description Add this unit's stats (eg HP, energy, resources) to this action's description
autoTriggerOnEvent: queueItemCancelled(withActionTag="#"), teleported, touchTargetSuccess, newWaypointGivenByPlayer, teamChanged, transportingNewUnit, transportUnloadedOrRemovedUnit, tookDamage(withTag="#"), newMessage(withTag="#"), enteredTransport, leftTransport, attachmentRemoved. withTag parameter for tookDamage uses tag from projectile and it is optional. withTag parameter for newMessage uses message tags.
setCustomTarget1: Changes unit height based on this height value Used for unit linking without requiring unit memories or markers. It is the unit that built this by default.
setCustomTarget2: markers. It is the unit that built this by default. Like setCustomTarget1 and with the same use. It is none by default.
sendMessageTo: default. Sends a message to a targeted unit
sendMessageWithTags: Useful for message detection in an autoTriggerOnEvent event, eg autoTriggerOnEvent:newMessage(withTag='xyz')
fireTurretXAtGround_withOffset: bypasses canShoot rules in turret. If not set player targets the ground with GUI, if a point is set this step is skipped
fireTurretXAtGround_withProjectile: this step is skipped Used with fireTurretXAtGround. Defaults to target turret's normal projectile.
offsetSelfAbsolute: Outcome - Position Offsets unit position absolutely by this point. Format: [x,y, height]
onActions: Automatically plays the animation on specified events. Options: move, attack, idle, underConstruction, underConstructionWithLinkedBuiltTime, queuedUnits, repair
onActionsQueuedUnitPlayAt: underConstructionWithLinkedBuiltTime, queuedUnits, repair For onAction: queuedUnits. Amount queue needs to reach before starting, set between 0-1
blendIn: before starting, set between 0-1 Blend with last animation for this time
blendOut: Blend with next animation for this time
KeyframeTimeScale: Play animation in reverse after it ends Scales all keyframe times, useful to make an animation faster/slower without changing everything
anyRuleInGroup: (Only require 1 of the rules in this group pass, instead of all. Use the same group name on other placement rules to create a group.)
searchTags: a group.) Search for any unit with at least one of these tags
searchTeam: Teams to include in search, can be: own|neutral|allyNotOwn|ally|enemy|any
excludeIncompleteBuildings: defaults to false. Might want to set to true depending on the requirement reason
minCount: Set min amount of units that need to be found in search. (eg needs to be near something). Defaults to 0
maxCount: needs to be near something). Defaults to 0 Set max amount of units before match fails (eg cannot be close to something). Defaults to unlimited
blocksPlacement: to something). Defaults to unlimited Defaults to true.
cannotPlaceMessage: Highly Recommended. Message shown to player if this rule fails (will be first failing rule if using anyRuleInGroup).
checkEachTile: fails (will be first failing rule if using anyRuleInGroup). defaults to true (set to false to only test unit center, true checks each tile under the unit which shows up on the placement grid. Can be easier to see requirements with true)
appendResourceInHUD_whenThisZero: HUD. Defaults as true. When set as false, allows appended resource to be hidden with the parent resource.
valueInStats: resource value Affects post game stats and replay leaderboard. Defaults to 1.
displayTextAppendResourceWithGap: Adds a space between this and the appended resource. Defaults as false.
